name: co-newbiz
description: New-business-review AI team and system. Owns the regulations, procedures, guidelines and checklists for new business development and their ongoing operation (axis A), implements and maintains them as a system (axis B), and performs the actual deal reviews on top of that (axis C). Covers Green Field (new establishment) and Brown Field (M&A), with proxy-chain demand estimation for industries that have no direct market data.

pm.reason: PM acts as New Business Review Lead: coordinates four domain leads (functional / technical / industry / region), enforces stage gates including the Entity IC to Group IC chain, approves ADRs, and owns release judgement. Workspace flat PM Gateway is preserved — domain leads are design and review owners, not dispatchers.

agent_manifest.notes: Agents are organised into four domains under agents/domains/ with _core/pm.md at the top. Roster of 34 is planned in the design doc section 5; files are created in Stage 0.2. PM dispatches specialists per stage gate as defined in procedures/*.yaml — no strict sequential pipeline.
